metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the mirror-skin vertical slice before Maya host execution.

No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from 31ca1f05baf372b34ab88aa5b2f89fb534173f06 to 538f860bb423a119c0d4b59adc296d7f5ff212a7; py_compile passed for mirror_skin.py, smoke.py, and skinning __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove mirror-skin behavior in a disposable Maya 2024 scene.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Create a symmetric disposable mesh with left/right influences.
Mirror weights across the X/YZ plane through the explicit mirror_skin API.
Verify an opposite-side influence transfer occurs and return SKINNING_MIRROR_SKIN_SMOKE_OK before shutdown.

metadata.purpose: Verify mirror-skin controls integrate into the existing AIMayaTool Skinning section without breaking bootstrap/UI launch.
acceptance: Verify AIMayaToolWindow exists after mirror-skin controls are integrated.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
